theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tes_plane_reduction
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid N)) (Q : Euclid N → Submodule ℝ (Euclid N)) (ξ : Euclid N) (σ a M h₁ : ℝ) (T T₁ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid N)), 0 < σ → 0 ≤ a → 0 < M → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (Q x).starProjection) μ → ENNReal.ofReal M ≤ μ (closedBall ξ σ) → ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ σ, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin N, ‖(Q x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - T₁.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a → (∀ x ∈ μ.support ∩ closedBall ξ σ, ‖(x - ξ) - T₁.starProjection (x - ξ)‖ ≤ h₁) → ∃ S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid N), (S = T ∨ S = T₁) ∧ ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ σ, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin N, ‖(Q x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a ∧ ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ σ, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin N, ‖(Q x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ σ, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin N, ‖(Q x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - T.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ ∧ ∀ x ∈ μ.support ∩ closedBall ξ σ, ‖(x - ξ) - S.starProjection (x - ξ)‖ ≤ h₁ + Real.sqrt (4 * a / M) * σ
